title: Hollis Recalls Digital Dive Computers Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The dive computer, when used with an optional integrated transmitter, can malfunction and display an incorrect tank pressure reading to the diver. A diver could unknowingly deplete their air supply based on the reading, resulting in drowning. Units: About 1,000.

title: Staples Recalls Office Chairs Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The base of the chair can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,350.

title: Angel’s Touch Collections Recalls Butterfly and Shell Lamps Due to Shock and Fire Hazards; Sold Exclusively at Cracker Barrel Old Country Store
summary: The lamps have exposed wiring at the base. This poses shock and fire hazards to consumers. Units: About 8,000.

title: Outdoor Solutions Hammock and Sunshade Recalled by H-E-B Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seam in the lounge of the hammock can open and rip, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 700.

title: Toys R Us Recalls Remote-Controlled Helicopters Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The rechargeable battery inside the helicopters can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers or nearby items. Units: About 6,500 in the U.S. and 900 in Canada.

title: Yamaha Recalls Big Bear ATVs Due to Crash Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The front shock absorber can break apart and cause the driver to lose control of the vehicle, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 100.

title: Home Depot Recalls Soleil Portable Fan Heaters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The portable fans plastic housing can melt, deform and catch fire during use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 107,000.

title: Krankcycle by Matrix with Detachable Seat Recalled by Johnson Health Tech Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The seat can unexpectedly detach from the Krankcycle's frame during use, posing a fall hazard to users. Units: About 2,200.

title: Lennox Hearth Products Recalls Fireplaces Due to Risk of Gas Leak and Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: Defective fireplace gas connectors can leak, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,500.

title: Viking Range Expands Recall of Built-In Refrigerators with Bottom Freezers Due to Injury Hazard; Doors Can Detach
summary: The refrigerator's doors can detach, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 31,000 (Viking refrigerators were previously recalled in 2009).

title: Big Lots Recalls Holiday Pathway Lights Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The lights use plated steel conductors and have a plastic coating and components that are not flame retardant, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 29,500.

title: Girls Boots Recalled By Renaissance Imports Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Academy Sports + Outdoors
summary: An exposed staple in the sole of the boot presents a laceration hazard to the consumer. Units: About 5,000.

title: Kids II Recalls Baby Einstein Activity Jumpers Due to Impact Hazard; Sun Toy Can Snap Backward
summary: The "sun" toy attachment on the activity jumper can rebound with force and injure the infant, posing an impact hazard. Units: About 400,000 and 8,500 in Canada.

title: Nan Far Woodworking Recalls Rockland Furniture Round Cribs Due to Entrapment, Suffocation and Fall Hazards; Sold Exclusively at jcpenney
summary: The crib's drop-side rails can malfunction, detach or otherwise fail. When this happens, the drop-side rail can fall out of position and create a space where an infant or toddler can become wedged or entrapped, posing a risk of strangulation or suffocation. title: Subaru Portable Gasoline Generators Recalled by Robin America Due to Fire, Burn Hazards
summary: The fuel tank can leak, posing a fire or burn hazard. Units: About 4,100 units in the United States and 490 units in Canada.

title: Macy's Recalls Infants' First Impressions Varsity Jackets Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The snaps on the jackets can come off, posing a choking hazard. Units: About 8,700.

title: Masterbuilt Manufacturing Recalls Electric Smokers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The wood chip tray can fail to slide securely into the smoker, causing the wood to combust and the smoker's cabinet door to blow open, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 11,000.

title: Boys’ Hooded Jackets Recalled by 5 Star Kids Apparel Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The recalled jackets have drawstrings with toggles inside the bottom hem and neck area, posing a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 48,000.

title: Industrial Revolution Recalls LED Lanterns Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at REI Stores
summary: The lantern's wall charger plug can fail during normal use, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 2,300.

title: Sears Reannounces Recall of Kenmore Dehumidifiers Due to Additional Reports of Fires, Burn, Low Consumer Response Rate
summary: The dehumidifiers can overheat, smoke, melt and catch on fire, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. Units: About 795,000 (previously recalled in August 2012).

title: Thermobaby Bath Seats Recalled by SCS Direct Due to Drowning Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Amazon.com
summary: The bath seats fail to meet federal safety standards, including the requirement for stability. Specifically, the bath seats can tip over, posing a risk of drowning to babies. Units: About 7,500.

title: Be Amazing! Toys Recalls Monster Science and Super Star Science Colossal Water Balls Due to Serious Ingestion Hazard
summary: The soft and colorful product can be easily mistaken by a child for candy. When the marble-sized toy is ingested, it can expand inside a child's body and cause intestinal obstructions, resulting in severe discomfort, vomiting, dehydration and could be life threatening. title: Far East Brokers Recalls Ladybug-themed Kids’ Outdoor Furniture Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The red surface paint on the furniture contains excessive levels of lead, a violation of the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 14,000.

title: JP Boden Recalls Kensington Court High Heel Shoes Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The heel on the shoe can loosen with wear and become unstable, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 190.

title: Bistro Chairs Recalled by Midwest-CBK Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The chair's metal frame can bend or break, posing a fall hazard to consumers. Units: About 550.
